metadata.article_title: Proof of documents by production of certified copies

article.title: Proof of documents by production of certified copies
article.content: Such certified copies may be produced in proof of the contents of the public documents or parts of the public documents of which they purport to be copies.
article.html:
76Proof of documents by production of certified copies

Section 76 · Part III · Chapter V · Public documents

Such certified copies may be produced in proof of the contents of the public documents or parts of the public documents of which they purport to be copies.
